characters.name: KASPAR
characters.description: Väike inimene, rõõmsameelne poiss, lühikeste pruunide juuste ja säravate siniste silmadega. Seljas erekollane t-särk ja sinised lühikesed püksid. Sõbralik ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: EVI
characters.description: Väike inimene, rõõmsameelne tüdruk, heledate patside ja suurte roheliste silmadega. Seljas roosa kleit ja rohelised sandaalid. Sõbralik ja mänguline näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: SÕBRALIK TUBA
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom with light blue walls and a soft patterned rug on the floor. A large wooden table is in the center, with two small wooden chairs. A window on the back wall shows a glimpse of green trees outside. A small wooden bookshelf is on the right wall, filled with colorful books. Warm, natural light fills the room. Cartoon style.

locations.name: PÄIKESELINE AED
locations.description: Bright, sunny backyard garden with lush green grass and a few colorful spring flowers blooming. A large, clear puddle of water reflects the blue sky. In the background, there are green bushes and a wooden fence. The atmosphere is cheerful and fresh. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Kaspar and Evi are sitting at the wooden table in the playroom. They are looking at each other and smiling, as if thinking of something fun. The room has light blue walls, a soft patterned rug, a bookshelf, and a window showing green trees outside. Warm light fills the room. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress and green sandals.

Kaspar and Evi are still sitting at the wooden table. Evi points excitedly towards some colorful paper on the table, and Kaspar nods, smiling. There is a stack of colorful paper in red, blue, and yellow on the table in front of them. The playroom has light blue walls, a soft patterned rug, a bookshelf, and a window showing green trees outside. Warm light fills the room. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress and green sandals.

Kaspar and Evi are actively folding colorful paper at the wooden table in the playroom, making paper boats. Colorful paper scraps in red, blue, and yellow are on the table. They are focused and happy. The playroom has light blue walls, a soft patterned rug, a bookshelf, and a window showing green trees outside. Warm light fills the room. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress and green sandals.

Kaspar and Evi are proudly standing next to the wooden table, holding up their finished paper boats. Kaspar holds a blue boat, and Evi holds a red boat. They are smiling at each other. The table still has some paper scraps. The playroom has light blue walls, a soft patterned rug, a bookshelf, and a window showing green trees outside. Warm light fills the room. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress and green sandals.

Kaspar and Evi are walking happily outside into the sunny backyard garden. They are holding their paper boats. Evi is now wearing small yellow rain boots, and Kaspar is wearing small green rain boots. Green grass and colorful spring flowers are visible in the bright garden. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress.

Kaspar and Evi stand at the edge of a large, clear puddle in the sunny backyard garden. They are looking down at the puddle with curiosity and excitement. They are still holding their paper boats (Kaspar has blue, Evi has red) and wearing their rain boots (Evi has yellow, Kaspar has green). Green grass and colorful spring flowers are around the puddle. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress.

Kaspar and Evi are carefully placing their paper boats into the large puddle in the sunny backyard garden. The blue boat and red boat are now floating on the clear water. They are kneeling slightly by the puddle, still wearing their rain boots (Evi has yellow, Kaspar has green). Green grass and colorful spring flowers are around them. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress.

The blue and red paper boats are floating gently on the clear water of the large puddle. Kaspar and Evi are watching them, smiling happily. They are standing near the puddle, wearing their rain boots (Evi has yellow, Kaspar has green). The sunny backyard garden is in the background with green grass and colorful spring flowers. Kaspar wears a yellow t-shirt and blue shorts. Evi wears a pink dress.

Kaspar and Evi are laughing joyfully, pointing at their floating paper boats in the puddle. They are very happy, their faces full of delight. They are standing near the puddle, wearing their rain boots (Evi has yellow, Kaspar has green). The sunny backyard garden is in the background with green grass and colorful spring flowers.
